component.name: Silent Hill 2: Enhanced Edition Setup
component.summary: Install and configure the SH2: Enhanced Edition mod on Linux

developer.name: Linux port; original Setup Tool by nipkownix & the SH2:EE project

description.p: A Linux-native port of the Silent Hill 2: Enhanced Edition Setup Tool and Configuration Tool, for the PC release of Silent Hill 2 (2002) running under Wine/Proton. It reads the same component manifest and settings schema as the official Windows tools, so it stays current with the project automatically.

ul.li: Download, verify, and install all Enhanced Edition components
Maintenance mode: update or uninstall an existing install
Full configuration editor for every d3d8.ini setting, including Speedrun Mode
Automatic Wine/Proton DLL-override setup (the project's d3d8 wrapper)
One-click "Add to Steam" as a non-Steam game, with launch options pre-filled

description.p: Silent Hill 2 PC is installed offline into an arbitrary folder, so you point the tool at wherever the game lives; it can also auto-detect installs inside common Wine/Proton prefixes (Steam, Lutris, Heroic, Bottles).
This project is not affiliated with Konami. The enhancements and the original Setup Tool are by the Silent Hill 2: Enhanced Edition project.
Adds an uninstaller: remove the Enhanced Edition files, restore your original sh2pc.exe, clear the Wine DLL overrides, and take the Steam shortcut back out of your library — each one optional.
The tool now remembers your installation and opens on a menu when it is already set up, so you can update it, launch the Configuration tool, or uninstall without locating the game again.

Installations can be cancelled part-way, and the downloaded files can be kept for offline reinstalls — either while installing, or at any time from the menu, without having to reinstall to get a copy of them.

Also fixes a crash on startup while scanning for the game. A Wine prefix's dosdevices folder maps the whole filesystem into the prefix, and unreadable directories under it took the wizard down before it could open.
Adds an AppImage download (double-click to run; manageable with Gear Lever).
Step-by-step setup wizard and a separate configuration app, with an animated fog theme. Adds offline install, Speedrun Mode parity, and Add-to-Steam with the WineD3D launch fix pre-filled.
Initial Linux release, tracking upstream Setup Tool 1.1.5.
